title: NANSEN data variable (DRAFT)
description: DRAFT, consumed from step 3. A named piece of an entity's data: which DSM file pattern holds it and which file adapter reads and writes it. It refers to the DSM membership pattern by name instead of repeating a file name expression.

filePattern.description: Name of a DSM filePatterns entry at the entity's level in that location.

fileAdapter.description: Id of a registered file adapter.

dataType.description: What the adapter returns, for example 'ImageStack' or 'RoiArray'.
